kinds.name: python_bytecode_cache
kinds.reason: Python bytecode cache; the interpreter rewrites it on the next import
kinds.regenerate: run any Python import of the module; nothing to restore by hand

kinds.name: pytest_cache
kinds.reason: pytest's own cache of last-failed and node ids

kinds.name: finished_prep_intermediates
kinds.reason: the _work and _export intermediates of a preparation that has finished (older than two days)
kinds.regenerate: run the preparation again from its own tool; its inputs are kept

kinds.name: unpacked_collected_evidence
kinds.reason: the unpacked copy of a collected run's evidence; the collected_evidence.tar.gz beside it is kept and its digest is recorded in collection_integrity.json
kinds.regenerate: tar -xzf collected_evidence.tar.gz into a new folder named downloaded in the run folder

kinds.name: refused_seal_folder
kinds.reason: a bundle folder the sealer or the preflight refused, never launched, older than a day
kinds.regenerate: seal the bundle again with the sealer under the same name

kinds.name: partial_seal_killed_for_memory
kinds.reason: a partial seal left by a host memory stop; D-222 restarts that job after removing its partial output, and the sealed folder of the same name exists
kinds.regenerate: seal the bundle again with the sealer (the unsuffixed folder already holds the restart)

kinds.name: superseded_worktree
kinds.reason: a lane worktree whose branch is merged into the loop branch and whose tree is clean; REPORTED ONLY in this version, never deleted
